page.note: Saved readable evidence reused; no new external lookup in this publication.

method: Reuse of saved readable evidence captured 2026-11-01/02 by one public LinkedIn guest posting request per card (jobs-guest/jobs/api/jobPosting/<id>), no sign-in, no proxy, no challenge solving.
transportDisclosure: Those original requests sent a generic browser User-Agent header ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)") and Accept-Language en-US, and the runner retried HTTP 429/5xx after a backoff. Both predate the current per-card rate-limit rule. No further LinkedIn requests are made under the current procedure. Coordinator may weigh this when accepting the evidence.
